latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Easily turn written copy into shareable videos.

- Upload text or script (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4, up to 200MB) and generate a ready-to-post 1080p MP4 with AI voiceover and visuals.
- No manual editing needed—just describe the video you want, and the backend handles generation via a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Built-in authentication with free credits for new users; all API setup and session management is handled automatically.
- Supports common workflows like quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Simple commands for checking credits, status, exporting video, and uploading files.
